chunks: To Us is surely their returning;
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that our return is to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ghashiyah underscores the inevitability of the Ma'ad (Resurrection), affirming that all souls must return to their Creator for accountability. It serves as a foundational reminder of divine sovereignty, linking the transient nature of worldly life to the eternal reality of standing before Allah.
